verdicts.reason: Both demote the SOLSTICE wordmark to below the headline, reverse the order of the flavour pills, centre the CTA under a left-aligned text column and leave a dead area at the bottom left. A also stacks the peach circle awkwardly inside the yellow one and drops the bottom-right accent circle. Its pills are mismatched in size and misaligned: Cucumber Mint is smaller and sits higher, and the row starts left of the text column. B keeps the original's two-circle composition and lines the pills up with the text column, though the pill labels are too small to read and the peach circle crowds behind the CTA and subcopy.
